name: Miriam
summary: A prophetess and the sister of Aaron and Moses, who led the women in song after the LORD's victory at the sea. She died at Kadesh in the desert of Zin.

key_moments.title: Leads the Women in Song
key_moments.description: Miriam took a timbrel, and all the women followed her with timbrels and dancing. She sang that the LORD had thrown horse and rider into the sea.

key_moments.title: Struck with Leprosy
key_moments.description: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses, and the LORD rebuked them at the tabernacle. Miriam became leprous, and after Moses prayed for her, she was kept outside the camp for seven days.

key_moments.title: Dies at Kadesh
key_moments.description: Israel reached the desert of Zin and stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.
